subject.title: fix: prevent encoded plugin prefix sibling matches

question: Should plugin prefix routing exclude valid percent-encoded sibling names while gateway auth continues to fail closed for malformed or decode-overflow paths?
rationale: The code is a narrow correction, but it changes a gateway route-claim/auth-boundary invariant and needs an owner to confirm the intended compatibility and security posture after rebase.

options.title: Rebase and retain the split
options.body: Rebase onto current main, preserve slash-only normal matching plus malformed-input fail-closed handling, and merge after focused checks pass.

options.title: Keep broad percent prefix matching
options.body: Retain the current behavior only if maintainers intentionally want a prefix route to claim valid percent-encoded sibling names despite their decoded path identity.

recommendation.title: Rebase and retain the split
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, preserve slash-only normal matching plus malformed-input fail-closed handling, and merge after focused checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available adjacent routing candidate for gateway security posture, though direct line-history ownership could not be confirmed.
